lines.text: Your agent works in a terminal. Your team talks in Slack. And you copy messages between them, all day.
Agent R Q connects any agent with one M C P config. And your team can hand it work from Slack.
Every workspace has a Setup tab. Pick your agent: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or any A C P agent.
Copy one M C P config into the project. Then one start command.
Claude Code opens with the workspace as a channel. New tasks reach it on their own.
Ada hands it a real task: the order export times out, so stream it. It reports back with the test output attached.
When it needs a decision, it asks on the task. Ada answers, and it carries on.
Now Slack. Add to Slack, and the workspace gets its own private channel.
Sam, on call this week, types slash T with a title. The task lands in Agent R Q, marked as from Slack.
When the agent needs approval, Allow and Deny post in the thread. Sam clicks Allow, and it carries on.
One config, any agent, and your team in Slack. Which tool should Agent R Q plug into next? Tell us in the comments, and try it at Agent R Q dot com.
